elsewhere.note: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.
He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee…
